claim.academic_qualification_date.descri: Date the student earned the qualification, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).
claim.academic_year.description: Academic year in which the student is enrolled (e.g. 2024/2025).
claim.address.description: Current residence address as a structured object containing street, house number, locality, locality fraction, postal code, region and country.
claim.age_over_18.description: Indicates whether the holder is over the age of majority (18 years) or not.
claim.birth_date.description: Date of birth, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). Also known as birthdate.
claim.birth_place.description: Place of birth as a free-text string as registered in official records.
claim.code.description: Condition or restriction code applicable to a driving licence category, as defined in ISO 18013-5.
claim.codes.description: Array of conditions and restrictions applicable to a vehicle category, each item containing a code, a sign and a value.
claim.constant_attendance_allowance.desc: Indicates whether the holder is entitled to a constant attendance allowance (true/false).
claim.consulate_code.description: Code identifying the consulate of reference for citizens registered as residents abroad (AIRE).
claim.consulate_name.description: Name of the consulate of reference for citizens registered as residents abroad (AIRE).
claim.content.description: Full content of the document encoded in Base64 (typically a PDF).
claim.country.description: Country code in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format (e.g. IT, DE).
claim.cpia_school_year.description: School year for CPIA (Provincial Centre for Adult Education) programmes.
claim.degree_class.description: Ministerial code of the degree class associated with the qualification completed by the student.
claim.degree_class_name.description: Name of the degree class associated with the qualification completed by the student.
claim.degree_course_name.description: Name of the degree course in which the student is enrolled or has graduated.
claim.degree_course_year.description: Year of the degree course in which the student is currently enrolled.
claim.document_iss_authority.description: Name of the administrative authority that issued the document.
claim.document_iss_country.description: Country of the document-issuing authority, as a two-letter country code defined in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.
claim.document_number.description: Document serial number or unique identifier.
claim.driving_privileges.description: Array of authorized vehicle categories, each item containing category code, issue date (ISO 8601), expiry date (ISO 8601) and applicable conditions and restrictions.
claim.education_degrees.description: List of academic degrees earned by the student, each item containing qualification date (ISO 8601), degree class, course name, institute, programme type and grade.
claim.education_enrollments.description: List of university enrolments of the student, each item containing academic year, degree class, course name, enrolment year and institute.
claim.educational_track.description: Educational track or study address within the school (e.g. scientific, humanistic, technical).
claim.effective_date.description: Date on which the current residence became effective, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).
claim.expiry_date.description: Document expiry date, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). Also known as date_of_expiry.
claim.family_name.description: Person's family name as it appears on official documents.
claim.foreign_residence.description: Indicates whether the person is registered as a resident abroad — AIRE (true/false).
claim.given_name.description: Person's given name(s) as they appear on official documents.
claim.house_number.description: House number of the residence address.
claim.institute_code.description: Unique identification code of the educational institution.
claim.institute_name.description: Name of the educational institution (school or university).
claim.issue_date.description: Document issue date, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).
claim.link_qr_code.description: URI of the QR code associated with the European Disability Card for online verification.
claim.locality.description: Locality (municipality or city) of the residence address.
claim.locality_fraction.description: Fraction or sub-locality of the residence address (hamlet or district within a municipality).
claim.nationalities.description: Array of nationalities of the person, each expressed as a two-letter country code defined in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.
claim.place_of_birth.description: Place of birth as a structured object containing country, region and locality.
claim.portrait.description: Person's photograph encoded in Base64 (JPEG or JPEG2000 format).
claim.postal_code.description: Postal code (CAP) of the residence address.
claim.professional_qualification.descrip: Professional qualification or specialisation obtained at the end of a vocational or technical school programme.
claim.programme_type_name.description: Name of the programme type for the student's qualification (e.g. Bachelor, Master, Single-cycle).
claim.qualification_grade_value.descript: Final grade value obtained by the student for the qualification (e.g. 110/110).
claim.qualification_name.description: Name of the qualification earned by the student (e.g. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science).
claim.qualification_type.description: Qualification type code according to the national classification (e.g. state exam, vocational diploma).
claim.qualification_type_description.des: Textual description of the qualification type.
claim.qualification_year.description: School year in which the qualification was achieved (e.g. 2023/2024).
claim.region.description: Region, province, state or district of the residence address.
claim.restrictions_conditions.descriptio: Textual description of restrictions or conditions applicable to the driving licence.
claim.school_attendance_type.description: Type of school attendance (e.g. full-time, part-time, distance learning).
claim.school_code.description: Unique code identifying the school within the national registry (MIM/MIUR code).
claim.school_course_year.description: Current year of the school course in which the student is enrolled (e.g. 3rd year).
claim.school_qualifications.description: List of scholastic qualifications earned by the student, each item containing school details, qualification type, grade and year.
claim.sign.description: Sign associated with a driving licence condition or restriction (e.g. '=', '≤').
claim.street_address.description: Street name of the residence address.
claim.tax_id_code.description: Italian fiscal identification code (Codice Fiscale), a 16-character alphanumeric code.
claim.un_distinguishing_sign.description: Distinguishing sign of the mDL-issuing country according to ISO/IEC 18013-1:2018, Annex F (e.g. I for Italy).
claim.value.description: Value associated with a driving licence condition or restriction (e.g. a numeric limit).
claim.vehicle_category_code.description: Vehicle category code according to EU Directive 2006/126/EC and ISO 18013-5 (e.g. A, B, C, D).
